exercises.question: Which sentence makes a comparison?
options: Este acento es más fácil de entender que aquel. [This accent is easier to understand than that one.]
Mi familia usa este acento en las fiestas. [My family uses this accent at parties.]
Hablo con mi familia y con mis amigos hoy. [I speak with my family and my friends today.]

exercises.sentence: Esta variedad es ___ clara que la otra.
exercises.english: This variety is clearer than the other one.
This accent is easier to understand than that one.

sentences: Esta variedad es interesante. [This variety is interesting.]
La otra también es interesante. [The other one is interesting too.]
Las dos variedades son tan interesantes como la otra. [The two varieties are as interesting as each other.]

exercises.question: Which means «as...as»?
options: tan...como [as...as]
más...que [more...than]
menos...que [less...than]

exercises.sentence: La gramática es tan importante ___ la pronunciación.
exercises.english: Grammar is as important as pronunciation.
Grammar is as important as pronunciation.

exercises.sentence: Este acento es más fácil de entender que aquel.
options: This accent is easier to understand than that one.
This accent is harder to understand than that one.
This accent is the same as that one.

exercises.sentence: Las dos variedades son tan interesantes como la otra.
options: The two varieties are as interesting as each other.
The two varieties are less interesting than the other one.
The two varieties are more interesting than the other one.

exercises.sentence: Esta variedad es menos conocida que la otra.
exercises.english: This variety is less well known than the other one.

options: Esta variedad me parece más fácil. [This variety seems easier to me.]
Esta variedad me parece más mejor. [This variety seems more better to me.]
Esta variedad me parece tan fácil que la otra. [This variety seems as easy that the other one.]
Sí, pero los dos son interesantes. [Yes, but both are interesting.]
Sí, uno es más mejor que el otro. [Yes, one is more better than the other.]
Sí, uno es tan fácil que el otro. [Yes, one is as easy that the other.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué es tan importante como la gramática?

options: La pronunciación también es importante. [Pronunciation is also important.]
La pronunciación es más importante como la gramática. [Pronunciation is more important as grammar.]
La pronunciación es tan importante que la gramática. [Pronunciation is as important that grammar.]

template.answer: Los dos acentos son diferentes, pero los dos son interesantes.
